player_prompt.intro:
Keddi Player {player_id} di JoJoJoin, yedwal ɣef tebṛat 5x5 s yizeggiwen yettwanumaren 0-24.
Di tedbelt-ik, ṛeẓ mark-ik ɣef yizeggiw ameɣtu, amedya '[12]'.
KEDDI T-RARAT ad tesɛu kṛad mark-ik di tedbelt — kṛad yizeggiwen id-yettnernan s waḍu, s azɣar, neɣ s aɣeṛṛab.
Akeddi Player {player_id} kedi '{symbol}'; amedyan-ik '{opponent_symbol}'.
